### SSH key-only authentication (Linux)
What: password auth disabled, keys only.
Why: removes the password-guessing attack surface.
How: sshd_config -> PermitRootLogin no, PasswordAuthentication no
Verify: sshd -T | grep -i passwordauthentication -> "no"
Owner: Security team. Review: quarterly.
caption: What, why, how, verify, owner -- the same five parts for every entry.
